Privacy

This site collects as little as it can and still work. Here is the whole list, in plain words, written by the students who run it.

No ads

Nothing is sold here, and nothing about you is sold either.

No trackers

No third-party analytics, no ad pixels, no fingerprinting scripts.

Do Not Track honored

If your browser sends it, even our anonymous page count skips you.

What you type into forms

When you submit a photo, request an announcement, nominate a senior, join the directory, or contact us, we store exactly the fields on that form: your name, your email, and whatever you wrote or attached.

Emails are used to reply to you or to verify an edit or removal request. They are never displayed on the site and never shared outside the site team.

Submissions sit in a private queue that only signed-in team members can see.

Anonymous page counts

To know which pages are useful, the site counts visits per page per day. That is the entire record: a path like /events, a date, and a number.

No IP addresses, no device IDs, no cookies for this, no linking a visit to a person. If your browser sends Do Not Track, the count is skipped entirely.

Photos and uploads

Uploaded images are stored on the site’s server until they are removed. Approved photos appear on the photos page with the credit you gave. Rejected uploads are deleted.

Anyone who appears in a photo can ask for it to come down, no reason needed.

Never collected or shown

No phone numbers. No home addresses. No birthdays or student IDs. The directory shows names, plans, activities, memories, and quotes only, and never any way to contact someone.

Email sign-ups store your address and which categories you picked. Emails start when notifications launch; until then the list exists only so we do not lose your place, and only the site team can see it.

Cookies and local storage

Your light-or-dark choice is saved in your browser only. Site team members get a login cookie when they sign in. Visitors get no cookies.

How to get something removed

Use the contact form and pick “Photo removal request” for photos, or “Other” for a directory entry, a spotlight, or a submission you sent us. Tell us what to find. We take it down first and ask questions, if any, after.

Directory entries and spotlights are also removed on request from the person they are about.

This site is student-operated and not run by Waukegan High School or Waukegan CUSD 60. If this page changes, the change is posted here and dated. Last reviewed September 2026.
